headline: FCA calls for disclaimers on AI financial advice
body: The UK's financial services watchdog is calling on AI providers to issue disclaimers for services that provide financial advice to consumers via agentic AI.
note: A call for disclaimers is a lighter step than a rule, and it points at firms that let AI agents give consumers advice.
